【文章原文节选】: Google Search Is Less Than 50% of Alphabet's Revenue for the First Time Ever | Company Atlas Skip to content 🏢 Company Atlas by Kadoa Search ⌘K Menu Companies Market cap Workforce Directors Holders Network IPOs Insights About New Insight: DoorDash is buying Instacart for $17 billion 29 Oct 2026 For the first time ever, Google Search is less than 50% of Alphabet's revenue In the quarter to Sep 2026 , Google Search made $63.4B of Alphabet's $128B in revenue, or 49.7% .
